scientific_integrity: Self-contained construction and necessity proof; exact exhaustive finite cross-checks are supplemental. The available 2025 source establishes appearance at M-PREF 2025; an earlier public manuscript may exist. Related results in integer bin packing may have equivalent formulations, and priority is subject to further expert verification.
scientific_limitations: All agents have identical additive integer item values; goods have exactly two denominations 1 and h; individual budgets are nonnegative integers, while zero-sum transfers may be real. General heterogeneous valuations, additional denominations, upper limits on receipts, and unrelated types are not treated.
title: Exact liquidity and budget-vector thresholds for two-denomination envy-free division
